# react-native design fixture

Two React Native components (`src/components.jsx`: PriorityChip, TripRow) styled with NativeWind 4 classes, shown on the web through react-native-web. Two routes: `/` and `/detail`. `design.md` is a filled example. No Babel step: esbuild's JSX import source `nativewind` plus compiled Tailwind 3 CSS is enough.

Install and start:

```
npm install
npm run web
```

Then open http://localhost:3200 (stop with Ctrl-C). It holds no credentials.
